name: Axis
description: Represents a single axis in a chart.
remarks: The Axis object is a member of the Axes collection. Use Axes ( _Type_, _AxisGroup_ ) where _Type_ is the axis type and _AxisGroup_ is the axis group to return a single Axis object. _Type_ can be one of the following XlAxisType constants: xlCategory, xlSeries, or xlValue. _AxisGroup_ can be one of the following XlAxisGroup constants: xlPrimary or xlSecondary. For more information, see the Axes method.
example:
With ActiveDocument.InlineShapes(1)

    If .HasChart Then

        With .Chart.Axes(xlCategory)

            .HasTitle = True

            .AxisTitle.Caption = "1994"

        End With

    End If

End With

properties.name: AxisBetweenCategories
properties.description: True if the value axis crosses the category axis between categories. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: AxisGroup
properties.description: Returns the type of axis group. Read-only XlAxisGroup.

properties.name: AxisTitle
properties.description: Returns the title of the specified axis. Read-only AxisTitle.

properties.name: CategoryNames
properties.description: Returns or sets all the category names as a text array for the specified axis. Read/write Variant.

properties.name: Crosses
properties.description: Returns or sets the point on the specified axis where the other axis crosses. Read/write Long.

properties.name: CrossesAt
properties.description: Returns or sets the point on the value axis where the category axis crosses it. Applies only to the value axis. Read/write Double.

properties.name: HasMajorGridlines
properties.description: True if the axis has major gridlines. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasMinorGridlines
properties.description: True if the axis has minor gridlines. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasTitle
properties.description: True if the axis or chart has a visible title. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MajorGridlines
properties.description: Returns the major gridlines for the specified axis. Read-only Gridlines.

properties.name: MajorTickMark
properties.description: Returns or sets the type of major tick mark for the specified axis. Read/write XlTickMark.

properties.name: MajorUnit
properties.description: Returns or sets the major units for the value axis. Read/write Double.

properties.name: LogBase
properties.description: Returns or sets the base of the logarithm when you are using log scales. Read/write Double.

properties.name: TickLabelSpacingIsAuto
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether the tick label spacing is automatic. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MajorUnitIsAuto
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word calculates the major units for the value axis. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MaximumScale
properties.description: Returns or sets the maximum value on the value axis. Read/write Double.

properties.name: MaximumScaleIsAuto
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word calculates the maximum value for the value axis. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MinimumScale
properties.description: Returns or sets the minimum value on the value axis. Read/write Double.

properties.name: MinimumScaleIsAuto
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word calculates the minimum value for the value axis. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MinorGridlines
properties.description: Returns the minor gridlines for the specified axis. Read-only Gridlines.

properties.name: MinorTickMark
properties.description: Returns or sets the type of minor tick mark for the specified axis. Read/write XlTickMark.

properties.name: MinorUnit
properties.description: Returns or sets the minor units on the value axis. Read/write Double.

properties.name: MinorUnitIsAuto
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word calculates minor units for the value axis. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ReversePlotOrder
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word plots data points from last to first. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ScaleType
properties.description: Returns or sets the value axis scale type. Read/write XlScaleType.

properties.name: TickLabelPosition
properties.description: Describes the position of tick-mark labels on the specified axis. Read/write XlTickLabelPosition.

properties.name: TickLabels
properties.description: Returns the tick-mark labels for the specified axis. Read-only TickLabels.

properties.name: TickLabelSpacing
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of categories or series between tick-mark labels. Read/write Long.

properties.name: TickMarkSpacing
properties.description: Returns or sets the number of categories or series between tick marks. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Returns the axis type. Read-only XlAxisType.

properties.name: BaseUnit
properties.description: Returns or sets the base unit for the specified category axis. Read/write XlTimeUnit.

properties.name: BaseUnitIsAuto
properties.description: True if Microsoft Word chooses appropriate base units for the specified category axis. The default is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: MajorUnitScale
properties.description: Returns or sets the major unit scale value for the category axis when the CategoryType property is set to xlTimeScale. Read/write XlTimeUnit.

properties.name: MinorUnitScale
properties.description: Returns or sets the minor unit scale value for the category axis when the CategoryType property is set to xlTimeScale. Read/write XlTimeUnit.

properties.name: CategoryType
properties.description: Returns or sets the category axis type. Read/write XlCategoryType.

properties.name: Left
properties.description: Returns the distance, in points, from the left edge of the object to the left edge of the chart area. Read-only Double.

properties.name: Top
properties.description: Returns the distance, in points, from the top edge of the object to the top of row 1 (on a worksheet) or the top of the chart area (on a chart). Read-only Double.

properties.name: Width
properties.description: Returns the width, in points, of the object. Read-only Double.

properties.name: Height
properties.description: Returns the height, in points, of the object. Read-only Double.

properties.name: DisplayUnit
properties.description: Returns or sets the unit label for the value axis. Read/write XlDisplayUnit, xlCustom, or xlNone.

properties.name: DisplayUnitCustom
properties.description: If the value of the DisplayUnit property is xlCustom, returns or sets the value of the displayed units. Read/write Double.

properties.name: HasDisplayUnitLabel
properties.description: True if the label specified by the DisplayUnit or DisplayUnitCustom property is displayed on the specified axis. The default is True. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: DisplayUnitLabel
properties.description: Returns the DisplayUnitLabel object for the specified axis. Returns null if the HasDisplayUnitLabel property is set to False. Read-only.

properties.name: Border
properties.description: Returns the border of the object. Read-only ChartBorder.

properties.name: Format
properties.description: Returns the line, fill, and effect formatting for the object. Read-only ChartFormat.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent for the specified object. Read-only Object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft PowerPoint application. When used with an object qualifier, returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return the application of that object). Read-only.
